Status: Proposed

Date: [YYYY-MM-DD]

## Context

[Which interaction is costly, nondeterministic, or difficult to reproduce? What does the current project do?]

## Decision

[Identify the interface, its contract, affected modules, production adapter, and controlled test adapter. Specify per-interface modes and overrides, production pass-through and development recorder defaults, direct integration-test wiring, and any trace/replay scope. Specify the configurable trace root, GUID directory naming, serialized payload format, and global trace ID propagation. Link to the applicable guides using paths relative to the completed ADR.]

## Correctness rules

[State observable properties that must hold, including relevant failure behavior.]

## Alternatives considered

[Include keeping the current design and explain why the selected scope is worthwhile.]

## Consequences

[Describe repeatability/testability gains, implementation and maintenance costs, and what this decision does not verify.]

## Verification

[Exact commands, expected results, isolation enforcement, fixture location, and a failure case that should be detected. Distinguish implemented checks from planned ones.]

## Adoption and exceptions

[Current implementation status, incremental steps, and any narrowly scoped exceptions or authorized live-check procedure. Mark Accepted when the project has actually adopted the decision. Record a later change in a superseding ADR.]
